source.title: Changes in the Board of Directors - September 2018
source.content:
We are happy to announce that the WCA Board of Directors has a new member: Chris Wright! 

An anonymous election took place among the WCA leaders and delegates in accordance with [Motion 5.2018.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/05.2018.1%20-%20Election%20of%20Directors.pdf) who approved Chris’s application. We are glad to bring Chris onto the WCA Board and we wish him luck in his new position.

These changes have become effective immediately.

Chris’s application can be viewed to all interested in seeing it [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1lV3bRMMWBdQ3bSo7JNRjd2GAN0IZ1Chi?usp=sharing).

translation.title: WCA 董事会成员变动（2018 年 9 月）
translation.content:
我们很高兴地宣布，Chris Wright 成为 WCA 董事会的新成员！

依照[动议 5.2018.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/05.2018.1%20-%20Election%20of%20Directors.pdf)，WCA 各负责人及代表进行了不记名投票，通过了 Chris 的申请。欢迎 Chris 加入 WCA 董事会，祝他在新的岗位上工作顺利。

这一变动立即生效。

有兴趣了解的成员可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1lV3bRMMWBdQ3bSo7JNRjd2GAN0IZ1Chi?usp=sharing)查看 Chris 的申请材料。
